title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) — AI-Enabled Quality Infrastructure
description:
SS\&C is a leading provider of mission\-critical, AI\-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid\-market firms, rely on SS\&C for expertise, scale, and technology.  



  

**Job Description**

  

As a leading financial services and healthcare technology company based on revenue, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has 27,000\+ employees in 35 countries. Some 20,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid\-market firms, rely on SS\&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Join our Quality Infrastructure team as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) and help build the AI\-assisted automation platforms that product development teams rely on every day. You will design, build, and maintain the frameworks, CI pipelines, and reporting systems that power end\-to\-end quality for the SS\&C Advent Eze investment platform — and you will be a primary driver of how AI\-assisted engineering practices reach the scrum teams we serve. We welcome candidates new to finance.


**Overview:** The SS\&C Advent™ solution is a born\-in\-the\-cloud investment solution that supports start\-up, emerging equity\-, and event\-focused hedge funds' full investment process in a single, unified platform through a secure web browser interface. The Quality Infrastructure team builds and operates the automation and quality tooling that product development scrum teams depend on. Our customers are the developers, testers, and scrum teams who add tests, consume dashboards, and rely on healthy CI to ship confidently. As an SDET on this team, you will build and improve the platforms and services behind that experience rather than writing product tests directly.


Your Impact Quality Infrastructure is a shared platform team, so your work reaches well beyond your own commits. The frameworks, pipelines, and dashboards you build are used every day by every product scrum team — which means when you build AI\-assisted capabilities into them (test scaffolding, failure triage, flaky\-test diagnosis, smarter alerting), you change how the entire engineering organization works, not just how one team tests. You will have real latitude to introduce AI\-assisted engineering practices here, and a direct hand in setting the standards other engineers follow.


**What You'll Do**

* Use AI\-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as a routine part of development, debugging, and test authoring — and help establish effective, well\-judged practices for its use across the engineering organization.
* Build AI\-assisted capabilities into the quality platforms product teams consume test\-generation scaffolding, automated failure categorization (environment vs. code vs. flaky), root\-cause summarization, and intelligent alert routing that reduces noise and surfaces signal.
* Develop, extend, and maintain automation frameworks used across multiple scrum teams (API\-level and UI\-level).
* Build and maintain CI pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) that execute end\-to\-end integration and regression suites, and reduce feedback\-loop time through smarter test selection and prioritization.
* Troubleshoot CI failures, flaky tests, and environment issues; support product teams in unblocking their workflows.
* Contribute to test\-reporting and alerting infrastructure: data pipelines, dashboards (Grafana), and integrations (PagerDuty, Slack,Teams).
* Collaborate with product scrum teams to understand their testing needs and translate them into framework features, CI improvements, and AI\-assisted workflows they will adopt.
* Participate in code reviews focusing on reliability, maintainability, and developer experience — including reviewing AI\-generated contributions with appropriate scrutiny.
* Document framework usage, onboarding guides, and runbooks — including guidance on where AI\-assisted workflows help and where they do not — so teams can self\-serve effectively.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2\-4 years of professional experience in software engineering, test automation, or a related SDET/QA engineering role.
* Hands\-on, practical use of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) in real development work, with demonstrated judgment about when to accept, verify, rewrite, or reject AI\-generated output.
* Solid programming skills in at least one language: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar.
* Hands\-on experience building or maintaining automated test suites (API, integration, or UI).
* Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Familiarity with version control workflows in Git (branching, pull requests, code review).\\
* Prior experience on a product development scrum team or in an Agile environment; understanding of the development lifecycle from feature work through deployment.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, clear written and verbal communication, and a service\-oriented mindset toward internal customers.
* Willingness to advocate for and teach AI\-assisted engineering practices to peers and partner teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI\-assisted automation into developer tooling, CI pipelines, or internal services.
* Exposure to agentic development tooling, prompt design, or evaluating AI output quality in an engineering workflow.
* Experience with Cypress, Playwright, or similar browser\-automation frameworks.
* Exposure to REST API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., pytest, Jest, Postman/Newman, custom frameworks).
* Familiarity with Docker/containers and cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
* Exposure to any observability or data tooling (Grafana, InfluxDB, ClickHouse, or similar time\-series/analytics databases).
* Experience with scripting around notifications or integrations (Slack bots, PagerDuty, AWS Lambda).
* Basic SQL and comfort working with structured data.
* Interest in developer experience, internal tooling, or platform engineering.

**About the scope of this role:** This is a software engineering role, not a machine learning or data science role — no model\-training or data science background is required. The AI work here is applied: using AI\-assisted tooling in your own engineering workflow and building AI\-assisted capabilities into the quality platforms our engineering teams use every day.  



  

**Why You Will Love It Here!**

* **Flexibility:** Hybrid Work Model and Business Casual Dress Code, including jeans
* **Your Future:** Provident Fund
* **Work/Life Balance:** Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Sick Leave, Paid Holidays
* **Your Wellbeing:** Mediclaim, Term Life Insurance, Accidental Coverage, Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave
* **Diversity \& Inclusion:** Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on Diversity
* **Training:** Hands\-On, Team\-Customized, including SS\&C University
* **Extra Perks:** Diwali voucher, Monthly remunerated RnR program

Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS\&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services.

  



Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.  



SS\&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.

title: Automation Engineer, Officer
description:
**Who we are:**

* Charles River Development (CRD) is the FinTech division of State Street. Together with State Street’s Middle and Back\-office services, Charles River’s cloud\-based Front Office technology forms the foundation of the State Street Alpha® Platform, the first front\-to\-back solution in the industry.
* Our vision is to be the world’s leading investment platform, shaping the future of the industry and driving new levels of technology\-led innovation, resiliency, efficiency and growth for investors and the people they serve.
* CRD Engineering organization is innovating and transforming the platform by moving away from monolithic software to utilising next generation cloud\-based technology that leverages Microsoft Azure, Kafka, Snowflake, etc.
* Industry momentum has seen CRD grow over 135% in headcount over the last 5 years, and we continue to grow. As a digital innovation leader, we invest into our solutions, processes, systems, and talent.
As a part of our talent growth strategy, CRD Engineering is actively hiring in Dublin as we are investing in growing our European presence. Our senior leadership team will be hosting in\-person interview panels during our recruiting drive in the late September 2024\.  
* 

  

**Summary:**

* Work as a senior member of automation center of excellence team to execute the overall quality plan for Charles River’s products. Provide support and assistance to customers and other teams within Charles River.
* The candidate should be a sharp automation framework engineer with strong problem\-solving skills and a solid automation test framework building foundation. This role requires a talented, detail oriented, enthusiastic individual who is passionate about quality with the ability to grasp tough issues quickly and deliver well engineered, high\-quality solutions.
* We are looking for a strong software engineer to build out the next generation of our software test automation framework and infrastructure as part of our Quality Assurance Infrastructure team. The candidate will be responsible for developing, delivering and supporting the software infrastructure that enables automated product validation. This position provides services for planning and the execution of central automated regression runs for all product departments. In addition, this candidate is responsible for maintaining and expanding the labs which host both automated and manual testing as well as conducting staging and certification of the product media during the ship\-stage of a release.
Financial services industry experience is preferred.  
* 

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Work closely with the scrum master, product owner, architect, business analysts, product specialists, developers and other project team members to assist in carrying out the software quality responsibilities of the Scrum team
* Expand the test automation framework capabilities needed to comprehensively test business requirements for all products and services
* Create pipelines to execute automated functional, integration, regression, and performance tests
* Maintain automated and manual test script libraries for functional, integration, regression, and performance testing
* Align with the Software Development Life Cycle practices, comply with Information Security and Data Governance practices
* Interpret results of automation tests and document software defects in issue tracking system; proactively communicate issues with developers and other project team members
* Provide testing leadership by identifying opportunities for improvement in the Scrum team’s QA methodology, innovate by researching and recommending new approaches to automation of testing, including use of Artificial Intelligence
* Adhere to a testing schedule to ensure efficient and effective product delivery
* Actively participate in the agile software development process by adhering to the CRD Scrum methodology including attending all daily standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives
* Participate in “testathon” activities as required by releases
Guide and mentor junior staff in best practices and proper creation of automated test scripts.  
* 

  

**Qualifications:**

**Education:**

B.S. degree (or foreign education equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, and Physics or other technical course of study or Business with an MIS background. MS degree strongly preferred.  



  

* **Experience:**
* 10\-12 years of experience in building test automation frameworks in enterprise world and in a process driven technology environment
* Demonstrated experience programming with JAVA, SQL and shell scripting languages such as PowerShell and Bash
* Demonstrated experience implementing automation framework with industry standard tools like Rest Assured, Playwright, Azure SDK, Kafka SDK, Cosmos DB, Swagger, Silk4Net, FlaUI, Talend strongly preferred
* Demonstrated experience implementing and executing automation test scripts against web, native/desktop applications, APIs and batch applications.
* Experience with creating and updating on\-demand pipelines and experience with relevant tools TeamCity, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Argo CD is preferred
* Demonstrated experience using test cases, scripts, and automated test tools for verifying requirements on multi\-tier applications
* Demonstrated ability translating business requirements into comprehensive functional and technical test plans
* Knowledgeable in one or more CRD functional areas is a plus
* A minimum of 3 years working with an Agile development methodology strongly desired
* Effective written and verbal communication.
  

**About State Street**
======================

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential.
